text: Code reviews are a vital practice in software development, where team members examine each other's code before it is merged. One of their main benefits is catching bugs early, which saves time and money compared to fixing issues after release. Beyond finding errors, reviews promote knowledge sharing—less experienced developers learn from seniors, while veterans gain fresh perspectives from new ideas. This process also builds team quality by encouraging consistent coding standards and open communication. Although reviews can sometimes feel time-consuming, they ultimately strengthen trust and collaboration, making the entire team more confident in the software they produce together.
